name: 炼金术师 NPC 轻量版

localizedNames.zh-Hans: 炼金术师 NPC 轻量版

localizedSummaries.en-US: This mod adds 7 NPCs (Alchemist, Brewer, Jeweler, Young Brewer, Operator, Architect and Musician), who sell potions, materials and some other stuff. New combinations of potions are sold by the Young Brewer.
localizedSummaries.zh-Hans: 添加炼金师、药剂师、珠宝师、年轻药剂师、操作员、建筑师、音乐家和工匠，提供药水、材料、组合药剂及便利道具。

authors.name: VVV101
authors.role: 原版 tModLoader 模组作者

summary: 添加炼金师、药剂师、珠宝师、年轻药剂师、操作员、建筑师、音乐家和工匠，提供药水、材料、组合药剂及便利道具。
